Call recording coming laterFor now, follow the written example below.
WRITTEN EXAMPLE · FICTIONAL CALLER AND DETAILS
  1. AI service receptionist

    Thanks for calling the workshop. I’m the AI service receptionist. How can I help?

  2. Caller

    I need to book a routine service for my car.

  3. AI service receptionist

    I can take the details for the team. What is your name, and what vehicle do you have?

  4. Caller

    Casey Morgan. It’s a 2019 Toyota Corolla, registration DEMO19.

  5. AI service receptionist

    Thank you. What day would suit, and can the team text this number with a time?

  6. Caller

    Friday morning, please. And yes, text is good.

  7. AI service receptionist

    I’ll send your routine service request to the workshop. They’ll confirm availability and any service details with you.
